title: Stability Analysis and Data-driven Verification via Recurrent Lyapunov Functions
summary: Lyapunov's direct method is a cornerstone of stability and control, but it hinges on finding a Lyapunov function, a task demanding ingenuity or computation. A key difficulty is that every sub-level set of the function must be forward invariant, coupling its geometry to the system's trajectories. We relax this by replacing invariance with recurrence: a set is recurrent if every trajectory starting in it returns within a finite time.
